patterns.note: Fixed header, footer, and left-aligned project counter frame a central, scrolling media-rich content area, creating a consistent viewport for dynamic content.
Minimalist sans-serif typography is used consistently for all UI elements and project titles, maintaining a clean and understated aesthetic that supports the visual content.
A stark monochromatic UI palette of white and black allows the vibrant, diverse colors of the photographic and video content to dominate the visual experience.

Fixed header, footer, and a left-aligned project counter remain static while large, full-width media blocks scroll vertically, sequentially revealing each project as the user progresses down the page.
Each project is presented as a distinct, full-width media block that occupies the majority of the central viewport, often accompanied by a small title and description below it.

technique_notes: The site uses a fixed positioning strategy for its header, footer, and a left-aligned project index. The main content area is a vertically scrolling container where large media blocks (images or videos, including a potential video hero at the top) are stacked, appearing one after another as the user scrolls down, creating an immersive, sequential portfolio viewing experience.
Content sections are presented as full-bleed media blocks that fill the central content area, creating an immersive visual experience where the UI elements recede to highlight the visuals.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small body text with slightly larger, but still understated, project titles, all in a clean sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with no visible rounded corners on any UI elements or media.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy side margins frame the central content, which features vertically stacked media blocks with minimal spacing between them.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its extremely minimal UI, which recedes entirely to allow a continuous, immersive scroll of large, high-quality photographic and video content to be the sole focus. It functions as a dynamic, full-screen visual portfolio.
